newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST - China GDP growth seen at 10 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - China GDP growth seen at 10 pct in Q1.

text.p: China's gross domestic product (GDP) growth is forecast to be about 10 percent in the first quarter, the China Securities quoted a report from the State Economic and Trade Commission as saying on Tuesday. Industrial output was seen growing by a year-on-year 13 percent in the first quarter to 455 billion yuan, it said.
Inflation would remain stable at about 4.5 percent in the first three months, the report said.
Retail sales of consumer goods were forecast to reach 680 billion yuan in the first quarter, increasing by an inflation-adjusted 13 percent from a year ago.
Fixed-asset investment by state firms would climb to 152 billion yuan in the first three months, a rise of 17 percent over the same period last year, the report said.
Trade in the first three months was forecast to grow a year-on-year three percent to $59 billion, it said.

Money in circulation was expected to be about 890 billion yuan by the end of March, with the broad M2 money supply to surge by 25 percent and M1, or cash in circulation plus current deposits, to rise by 17 percent, it said.
Bank deposits would increase by 300 billion yuan from the beginning of this year to 5.260 trillion yuan by the end of March, up by 26 percent over the same period last year, it said.
Bank loans would climb to five trillion yuan, increasing by 255 billion yuan from end-1996, or a rise of 24 percent compared with the same period last year, the report said.
